ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The following figure shows a geological and geomorphological map of a certain region of China; the four locations 1234 are located in different strata. <image1> According to the figure, which type of natural landscape does the west side of Helan Mountain mainly correspond to?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: the upper left part of the figure is labeled “Helan Mountain,” on its east side “Yinchuan Plain” can be seen, and farther to the east it is labeled “Yellow River.” The question requires judging the natural landscape type on the “west side of Helan Mountain.” Reasoning: from the spatial combination of “Helan Mountain—Yinchuan Plain—Yellow River,” it can be located in northern Ningxia and the edge of Alxa in Inner Mongolia. The west side of Helan Mountain enters the direction of the Alxa Plateau, where moisture conditions are relatively poor, precipitation is low, and vegetation transitions from grassland to desert; therefore, the main natural landscape is not typical temperate grassland, but temperate desert grassland.

raw_record.question_text:
The following figure shows a geological and geomorphological map of a certain region of China; the four locations 1234 are located in different strata.

<image1>

According to the figure, which type of natural landscape does the west side of Helan Mountain mainly correspond to?

method.method_draft: 先从图像读出地名与相对位置：图中左上为“贺兰山”，其东侧是“银川平原”和“黄河”。题干要求判断“贺兰山西侧”的自然景观类型。由贺兰山—银川平原—黄河的组合定位到宁夏北部、内蒙古阿拉善边缘地区；贺兰山以西进入阿拉善高原/荒漠过渡区，降水少，天然植被不是典型草原，而是温带荒漠草原。因此答案为“温带荒漠草原”。
